rows.surface: śārṅgāya [śārṅgāya saśarāya huṃ phaṭ ||] saśarāyeti huṃphaṭ
rows.gloss: to-bow-holder to-with-arrow huṃ phaṭ thus huṃ-phaṭ
rows.grounds: śārṅgāya = to-the-holder-of-Śārṅga-bow; saśarāya = to-the-one-with-arrow; huṃ phaṭ = mantra syllables (bīja, transliterated only); iti = thus; bracketed text gives the mantra form as printed in the witness
japyaḥ (sandhi japyo) = to be recited/chanted; navāyutam = nine ayutas, i.e. ninety-thousand; states the number of recitations
